subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers repair/adopt the conflicting cross-repo Feishu candidate or open a fresh target-repo fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug is still source-reproducible, but the exact open candidate is outside the target repo, conflicting, and based on a previously rejected shape that needs safer mention and root-routing behavior.

options.title: Repair or replace the candidate
options.body: Use the existing branch as context but land a current-main target-repo fix with bot-specific dropped-mention detection and routing tests.

options.title: Wait on the fork author
options.body: Keep this issue open while asking the fork PR author to rebase and address the previous safety concerns.

options.title: Defer the Feishu reply fix
options.body: Leave this as an open known bug without starting another repair lane until Feishu maintenance bandwidth is available.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace the candidate
recommendation.body: Use the existing branch as context but land a current-main target-repo fix with bot-specific dropped-mention detection and routing tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu mention-handling work makes this the closest available routing candidate for deciding the safe mention-detection shape.
